events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probe file commit and push state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git status --short -- app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts cloud/src/settings.ts; git log --oneline -3 -- app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git branch -r --contains $(git log -1 --format=%H -- app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs) | head; git diff origin/main --stat -- app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs; sed -n 1,30p app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs | grep -n -i -E "usage|node|port|sim" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how to start local centre and sim
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,14p app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs; grep -o -E '(wrangler dev[^"]{0,200}|vendor-sim[^"]{0,150})' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json | sort -u | head -8; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for stack start helpers and dev var names
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/tasks/activity/ | grep 291; grep -rl "8961" app/scripts/*.sh cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | head; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E "sim|stack" ; grep -c . cloud/.dev.vars; grep -o -E "^[A-Z_]+" cloud/.dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe-stack helper header
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-stack.mjs | head -40; ls scripts | grep -i sim; find . -name "vendor-sim.py" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Extract past stack-start commands from activity

events.text: Checking how to start the local centre and vendor sim so I can re-run the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: See sim port config and wrangler vars
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,25p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | grep -i -E "port|usage|run" ; grep -n -E "_BASE|_URL|SIM" cloud/wrangler.toml | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find wrangler config and sim wiring
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; ls wrangler* ; grep -n -i -E "8792|sim|vars" wrangler.json* 2>/dev/null | head -15; grep -rn "8792\|VENDOR_BASE\|SIM_BASE" src/*.ts | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how probe wires the sim
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "SIM" app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs | head -8; grep -n "d1\|migrat" app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs | head -5

events.text: Starting a fresh local centre (port 8961) and vendor simulator (8883) to re-run the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start vendor sim and local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/t291.XXXX); echo $T > /tmp/t291.dir; SIM_PORT=8883 SIM_STATE=$T/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > $T/sim.log 2>&1 &

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the preview-close probe locally
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; set -a; . ../cloud/.dev.vars; set +a; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8883 node scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs > /tmp/t291.out 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -c "^PASS" /tmp/t291.out; grep -v "^PASS" /tmp/t291.out | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Stop local stack, check live preview and hashes
events.input: $ pkill -f "wrangler dev --port 8961"; pkill -f "vendor-sim.py"; sleep 1; rm -rf "$(cat /tmp/t291.dir)"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "live /preview %{http_code}\n" "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/preview?v=t291-1011"; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git rev-parse --short origin/main; git log -1 --format=%h -- app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs; grep -c "needs_from_owner" /dev/null; python3 -c "import json;t=[x for x in json.load(open('workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json'))['tasks'] if x['id']=='T-291'][0];print(repr(t.get('needs_from_owner')))" 2>&1|tail -1
